title: Mango Icebox Cake with Cardamom
changes_from_base: A chilled cake of savoiardi sponge fingers and a mango, mascarpone and Italian meringue filling with cardamom, topped with mango roses, instead of sponge and ice cream.
summary: A striking charlotte-style mango cake with cardamom-scented mascarpone filling, ringed with sponge fingers and crowned with mango flowers.

ingredients.note: 60 ml with the gelatine, 60 ml in the syrup

ingredients.item: medium ripe but firm mangoes, peeled and cut into 5 mm dice

ingredients.note: 50 g for the purée, 200 g for the syrup

ingredients.item: light corn syrup or glucose syrup
large egg whites, at room temperature
fine sea salt or table salt
savoiardi sponge fingers (2 packs of 200 g)

steps.title: Bloom
steps.text: Soak 7 g gelatine and 1½ tsp ground cardamom in 60 ml water for 5 min, microwave for 45 s, then leave to cool for 5-7 min.

steps.title: Blend
steps.text: Blend 240 ml of the diced mango with 50 g sugar and 1 tsp lime juice until smooth.

steps.title: Boil
steps.text: Dissolve 200 g sugar, 60 ml water and the light corn or glucose syrup over medium-low heat, then boil to 114 °C, about 5 min.

steps.title: Meringue
steps.text: Whisk 4 egg whites with the vanilla seeds and ¾ tsp salt to soft peaks, pour in the hot syrup with the mixer running and whisk until cool, thick and glossy, about 7 min, then beat in the bloomed gelatine.

steps.title: Fold
steps.text: Whisk the mascarpone, condensed milk and mango purée together, fold in a third of the meringue followed by the rest, then fold in the remaining diced mango.

steps.title: Build
steps.text: Scatter half the broken sponge fingers over the lined tin base, spread half the filling leaving a 2.5 cm gap, stand the 24 trimmed sponge fingers upright around the edge and spread the filling to meet them.

steps.title: Repeat
steps.text: Scatter over the rest of the broken sponge fingers, pressing in, then spread over the remaining filling.

steps.title: Decorate
steps.text: Peel the topping mangoes into thin strips, toss with 2 tsp lime juice, roll into flower shapes and arrange over the top.

steps.title: Chill
steps.text: Cover loosely and chill for at least 4 h until set, then release from the tin and serve chilled.

tips: Choose mangoes that are ripe but still firm, so the diced fruit and the peeled topping strips rolled into mango roses hold their shape.
Check the gelatine packet, as it is sourced from beef.
Choose mangoes that are ripe but still firm so the diced fruit and the peeled topping strips hold their shape.
safety: Use pasteurised egg whites for the meringue if serving pregnant women, young children, older people or anyone unwell, as it may not fully reach 71 °C.
storage: This is a chilled rather than frozen cake, so keep it covered in the fridge.
